dishes.name: Tacos al pastor
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate oyster or portobello mushrooms in the same guajillo-achiote adobo and sear them hard with pineapple instead of spit-roasting pork.
dishes.technique: Meat marinated in a dried-chile and achiote adobo is roasted on a vertical spit (trompo) and shaved thin onto tortillas with pineapple, a method inherited from Lebanese shawarma.

sources.title: Vegan Al Pastor Tacos - Crowded Kitchen

dishes.name: Carnitas
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer young green jackfruit with orange, garlic and oregano until tender, then shred it and crisp it in a hot pan to mimic confit pork.
dishes.technique: Pork is slowly confited in its own lard in a copper cazo until tender, then the heat is raised so the edges turn crisp and caramelized.

sources.title: Vegan jackfruit carnitas tacos - Los Angeles Times

dishes.name: Birria
dishes.veganApproach: Shredded oyster or king oyster mushrooms are simmered in the guajillo consommé, and tortillas are dipped in the red broth and griddled into tacos.
dishes.technique: Meat is marinated in a dried-chile adobo and slowly braised in a sealed pot until it yields a rich consommé served alongside for dipping.

dishes.name: Barbacoa
dishes.veganApproach: Braise shredded oyster or maitake mushrooms in a guajillo-ancho adobo until tender and juicy, then serve in tortillas with onion and cilantro.
dishes.technique: Lamb wrapped in maguey leaves is slow-cooked overnight in an underground pit oven, yielding meltingly tender meat and a broth (consomé).

sources.title: Vegan Barbacoa Mushroom Tacos - Vegan Richa

dishes.name: Tacos dorados de papa
dishes.veganApproach: The mashed potato filling is already vegan; top with a cashew crema and a plant-based crumbled cheese instead of dairy.
dishes.technique: Tortillas are rolled tightly around a seasoned potato mash, secured and fried until shatteringly crisp, then topped with salsa, lettuce and crema.

sources.title: Potato Taquitos (Tacos Dorados de Papa) - Cuerna Kitchen

dishes.name: Tacos de pescado
dishes.veganApproach: Beer-batter strips of extra-firm tofu and serve them with shredded cabbage, salsa and an eggless lime crema.
dishes.technique: Strips of white fish are dipped in a light beer batter and deep-fried, then served on corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, crema and salsa.

sources.title: Classic Ensenada Fish Tacos - Rick Bayless
Baja Tofu Tacos - The Curious Chickpea

dishes.name: Tinga
dishes.veganApproach: Shredded oyster mushrooms (or jackfruit or soy curls) and cabbage are simmered in the chipotle-tomato salsa and served with vegan crema and cotija.
dishes.technique: Shredded meat and plenty of sliced onion are simmered in a blended tomato-chipotle salsa until thick, then piled on bean-smeared tostadas.

sources.title: Best Vegan Tinga - Mexican Made Meatless
Vegan Mushroom Tinga - No Frills Kitchen

dishes.name: Tacos de canasta
aliases: tacos de canasta de frijol y papa
dishes.veganApproach: Stick to the classic bean and potato-chile fillings and brush the tortillas with chile-infused oil instead of lard.
dishes.technique: Filled tacos are dipped in hot chile oil and packed tightly in a cloth-lined basket so they steam in their own heat and turn soft and glossy.

sources.title: Tacos de Canasta - Broke Bank Vegan
Tacos de canasta, receta fácil - Directo al Paladar

dishes.name: Quesadillas de flor de calabaza
dishes.technique: Fresh masa tortillas are griddled on a comal and folded around sautéed squash blossoms and melting quesillo until crisp at the edges.

sources.title: Quesadillas de Flor de Calabaza - Masienda
Quesadillas de flor de calabaza - Pati Jinich

dishes.name: Sopes
dishes.nameEn: Thick masa cakes with beans and toppings
dishes.veganApproach: Top with refried beans cooked in oil, salsa verde, avocado and a cashew crema instead of cheese and cream.
dishes.technique: Thick masa discs are griddled, their edges pinched up into a rim, then crisped in a little oil and loaded with beans and salsa.

sources.title: Easy Sopes Recipe - Broke Bank Vegan
Vegan Sopes With Refried Beans and Salsa Verde - Serious Eats

dishes.name: Gorditas
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the pockets with refried pinto beans, salsa and vegetables, leaving out the cheese or using a vegan one.
dishes.technique: Thick masa cakes are cooked on a comal until they puff, then split open like a pita and stuffed with a guisado.

sources.title: Vegan Gorditas With Refried Pinto Beans - VegNews

dishes.name: Huaraches
dishes.veganApproach: Top with beans, sautéed nopales and both salsas, and skip the cheese or use a plant-based crumble.
dishes.technique: Masa is stuffed with refried beans and flattened into a long sandal-shaped oval before being griddled and topped.

sources.title: Huaraches con Nopales y Frijoles de Olla - Culture Cheese Magazine

dishes.name: Tlacoyos
dishes.veganApproach: Naturally vegan when topped only with nopales, salsa, onion and cilantro; simply skip the cheese.
dishes.technique: Masa is wrapped around a seasoned fava bean or bean paste, shaped into a pointed oval and cooked on a dry comal.

sources.title: Tlacoyos de masa azul de haba con huevo y nopales - Pati Jinich

dishes.name: Tlayudas
dishes.veganApproach: Spread the tortilla with black beans fried in oil instead of asiento and top with avocado, cabbage, mushrooms and salsa instead of quesillo.
dishes.technique: A large, thin, semi-dried tortilla is smeared with asiento and black bean paste, topped, folded and toasted over charcoal until crisp.

sources.title: Prepared Tlayudas, Vegetarian and With Tasajo - My Slice of Mexico
Tlayudas de Oaxaca - Feasting at Home

dishes.name: Burrito
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the flour tortillas with oil-fried refried beans and a vegetable or soy guisado, leaving out the cheese.
dishes.technique: Large flour tortillas are warmed on the comal and rolled tightly around a single guisado, border-style, without rice.

sources.title: El burrito, icono de la frontera de Ciudad Juárez - El Diario de Juárez

dishes.name: Enchiladas verdes
dishes.veganApproach: Fill with shredded jackfruit or beans and potatoes, and finish with a cashew crema instead of dairy.
dishes.technique: Tortillas are briefly fried, dipped in a cooked tomatillo-serrano salsa, rolled around the filling and topped with crema, cheese and raw onion.

sources.title: Enchiladas Verdes with Oaxaca Cheese and Poblano - Mexican Made Meatless
Vegan Enchiladas Verdes with Jackfruit - Daily Dose of Vegan

dishes.name: Enchiladas rojas
dishes.veganApproach: Fill with sautéed potatoes and carrots or beans and top with a plant-based queso fresco.
dishes.technique: Tortillas are dipped in a smooth sauce of rehydrated guajillo and ancho chiles, flash-fried and rolled around the filling.

dishes.name: Enchiladas suizas
dishes.veganApproach: Fill with mashed chickpeas and mushrooms and blend silken tofu into the roasted tomatillo sauce for creaminess.
dishes.technique: Chicken enchiladas are bathed in a cream-enriched tomatillo sauce, covered with cheese and gratinéed in the oven, a Sanborns café creation.

sources.title: Sanborns and the Enchiladas Suizas - Saveur
Las enchiladas suizas se inventaron en Sanborns - El Financiero
Vegan Enchiladas Verdes Suizas - Healthy Simple Yum

dishes.name: Enchiladas potosinas
dishes.nameEn: San Luis Potosí red-masa cheese enchiladas
dishes.technique: Masa kneaded with red chile purée is pressed into small tortillas, filled with cheese and onion, folded into half-moons and griddled or fried.

sources.title: Enchiladas Potosinas (Red Chile Tortilla Cheese Enchiladas) - Piña en la Cocina

dishes.name: Enfrijoladas
dishes.veganApproach: The bean sauce is naturally vegan; finish with avocado, onion and a plant-based crema instead of cheese.
dishes.technique: Warm tortillas are dipped in a silky purée of black beans and chile, folded into quarters or rolled, and garnished.

sources.title: Enfrijoladas with Black Beans - Simply Recipes

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.veganApproach: Toss crisp tortilla chips in salsa verde and top with cashew crema, avocado and refried beans or a tofu scramble.
dishes.technique: Day-old tortillas are cut into wedges, fried crisp, then simmered briefly in salsa so they soften at the edges but keep some bite.

dishes.name: Papadzules
dishes.nameEn: Yucatecan egg enchiladas in pumpkin-seed sauce
dishes.technique: Tortillas are dipped in a pale-green sauce of toasted ground pumpkin seeds and epazote, rolled around chopped egg and topped with a tomato-habanero sauce.

dishes.name: Pastel azteca
dishes.technique: Lightly fried tortillas are layered like lasagna with salsa verde, roasted poblano rajas, cream and cheese, then baked until bubbling.

sources.title: Pastel Azteca of Roasted Poblano Rajas, Salsa Verde and Two Cheeses - Rick Bayless

dishes.name: Huevos rancheros
dishes.veganApproach: Replace the fried eggs with seared tofu slices or a tofu scramble set over the tortillas and salsa ranchera.
dishes.technique: Fried eggs sit on lightly fried corn tortillas and are smothered with a cooked tomato-chile salsa ranchera, with beans on the side.

sources.title: Vegan Huevos Rancheros - Sweet Simple Vegan
Vegan Tofu Rancheros - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Huevos a la mexicana
dishes.veganApproach: Crumble and season firm tofu and scramble it with the same sautéed tomato, onion and serrano.
dishes.technique: Onion, tomato and serrano, the colors of the Mexican flag, are sautéed first and the eggs are scrambled into the vegetables.

sources.title: Huevos a la Mexicana (Mexican Tofu Scramble) - Mexican Made Meatless
Tofu a la mexicana - Piloncillo y Vainilla

dishes.name: Huevos motuleños
dishes.technique: Fried eggs on bean-smeared crisp tortillas are covered with a habanero-tomato sauce and garnished with peas, diced ham, cheese and fried plantain.

sources.title: Huevos Motuleños (Eggs Motul Style) - Mexico in My Kitchen

dishes.name: Chiles rellenos
dishes.veganApproach: Stuff roasted poblanos with black beans, potatoes or vegan cheese and bake them instead of coating them in egg batter.
dishes.technique: Roasted, peeled poblanos are stuffed with cheese, coated in whipped egg batter (capeado) and fried, then served in a light tomato broth.

sources.title: Vegan Chiles Rellenos - Mexican Made Meatless
Roasted Chile Rellenos with Black Beans - Feasting at Home

dishes.name: Chiles en nogada
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the chiles with a fruit-studded plant-based picadillo and make the nogada from walnuts blended with plant milk instead of cream and cheese.
dishes.technique: Roasted poblanos filled with a sweet-savory fruit and meat picadillo are covered with a cold walnut cream and pomegranate, echoing the flag's colors.

sources.title: Vegan Chiles en Nogada - Dora's Table
Chiles en Nogada Vegetarianos - Mexican Made Meatless

dishes.name: Tamales
dishes.veganApproach: Beat the masa with vegetable shortening or oil instead of lard and fill it with red-chile-simmered vegetables, beans or jackfruit.
dishes.technique: Masa whipped with fat and broth is spread on soaked corn husks, filled, folded and steamed upright until it pulls cleanly from the husk.

sources.title: Vegan Tamales Rojos - Mexican Made Meatless

dishes.name: Molletes
dishes.technique: Split bolillos are buttered, spread with refried beans, topped with melting cheese and broiled, then finished with fresh pico de gallo.

sources.title: Molletes (Refried Bean and Cheese Melts) - The Washington Post

dishes.name: Torta ahogada
dishes.veganApproach: Fill the crusty roll with refried beans or plant-based carnitas and drown it in the same tomato and chile de árbol sauces.
dishes.technique: A crusty, salty birote roll stuffed with carnitas is drowned in a mild tomato sauce and a fiery chile de árbol sauce.

sources.title: Torta Ahogada Recipe (Vegan Mexico Cookbook) - Dora's Table

dishes.name: Espagueti verde
dishes.technique: Charred, peeled poblanos are blended with crema, cheese and cilantro into a pale-green sauce that coats the spaghetti.

sources.title: Espagueti Verde (Creamy Roasted Poblano Pasta) - NYT Cooking
Espagueti Verde (Creamy Poblano Spaghetti) - Mexican Made Meatless

dishes.name: Mole poblano
dishes.veganApproach: The sauce is naturally vegan when made with oil and vegetable stock; serve it in mushroom enmoladas or over potatoes, chayote and zucchini.
dishes.technique: Toasted dried chiles, nuts, seeds, spices, fruit, bread and chocolate are fried, ground and slowly cooked into a dark, glossy sauce.

sources.title: How to Make Authentic Mole Poblano From Scratch - Dora's Table

dishes.name: Mole negro
dishes.veganApproach: Cook the mole with oil and vegetable broth and serve it with roasted vegetables or mushrooms instead of chicken.
dishes.technique: Chiles and their seeds are toasted until nearly black, then ground with charred aromatics, spices and chocolate into Oaxaca's darkest mole.

dishes.name: Mole amarillo
dishes.veganApproach: A traditional meatless version simmers green beans, chayote and potatoes in the masa-thickened chile sauce, often with chochoyote masa dumplings.
dishes.technique: A sauce of chiles and tomatillos is thickened with fresh masa and perfumed with hoja santa, then used to simmer meat or vegetables.

sources.title: Mole Amarillo Recipe - Mexico in My Kitchen
Mole Amarillo with Roasted Veggies and Corn Masa Dumplings - Lemon Vinaigrette

dishes.name: Pipián verde
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer seasonal vegetables such as zucchini, chayote and green beans in the pumpkin-seed sauce made with vegetable broth.
dishes.technique: Toasted pumpkin seeds are ground with tomatillos, fresh chiles and green herbs, then fried and thinned into a velvety green sauce.

sources.title: Pipián Verde con Verduras - Pati Jinich

dishes.name: Cochinita pibil
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate young green jackfruit in achiote and citrus, wrap it in banana leaves and roast until it shreds like pulled pork.
dishes.technique: Pork marinated in achiote and sour orange is wrapped in banana leaves and slow-roasted in an underground pib oven.

dishes.name: Puerco en salsa verde
aliases: guisado de puerco en salsa verde
carne de puerco en salsa verde
dishes.veganApproach: Use rehydrated soy curls or TVP simmered with potatoes and Mexican zucchini in the tomatillo-serrano salsa.
dishes.technique: Browned or simmered pork is stewed in a boiled-and-blended tomatillo and green chile salsa until tender.

sources.title: Puerco en Salsa Verde (Pork in a Green Sauce) - Mexican Food Memories
Pork and Greens in Salsa Verde (Pati Jinich) - Mexico Rico
Vegan Chile Verde (Guisado en Salsa Verde) - Dora's Table

dishes.name: Rajas con crema
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer the roasted poblano strips and corn in a blended plant-based cream, such as cashew, instead of Mexican crema.
dishes.technique: Poblanos are charred, sweated, peeled and cut into strips (rajas), then simmered with onion, corn and crema.

sources.title: Vegan Rajas con Crema - Ale Cooks
Creamy Poblano and Corn Tacos (Rajas con Crema) - Forks Over Knives

dishes.name: Picadillo
dishes.nameEn: Mexican minced meat and vegetable hash
dishes.veganApproach: Brown lentils simmered with the diced potatoes, carrots and tomato sauce replace the ground beef.
dishes.technique: Ground meat is browned with onion and garlic, then simmered with diced potatoes, carrots and a light tomato sauce until thick.

sources.title: Picadillo de Lentejas (Lentil Picadillo) - Dora's Table

dishes.name: Frijoles charros
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer pinto beans with vegan chorizo or smoked paprika and plenty of tomato and jalapeño instead of bacon.
dishes.technique: Pinto beans are simmered in their broth with fried pork, tomato, onion and chiles until smoky and soupy.

sources.title: Vegan Frijoles Charros (Mexican Cowboy Beans) - Dora's Table
Frijoles Charros (Charro Beans) - Mexican Made Meatless

dishes.name: Pozole rojo
dishes.veganApproach: Use hearty black and pinto beans, or jackfruit, instead of pork in the guajillo broth with hominy.
dishes.technique: Nixtamalized corn kernels are simmered until they bloom, then combined with a red chile broth and served with crisp raw garnishes.

dishes.name: Pozole verde
dishes.veganApproach: Simmer hominy with white beans and mushrooms in the pumpkin-seed and tomatillo broth built on vegetable stock.
dishes.technique: The broth gets its color and body from a blended sauce of tomatillos, green chiles, herbs and toasted pumpkin seeds.

dishes.name: Sopa de tortilla
dishes.veganApproach: Build the tomato-pasilla broth on vegetable stock and garnish with avocado and a cashew crema instead of cheese and cream.
dishes.technique: A tomato and chile purée is fried and simmered in broth, then poured over crisp fried tortilla strips with avocado, cheese and crumbled pasilla.

sources.title: Authentic Mexican Tortilla Soup - Mexican Made Meatless
Vegan Tortilla Soup - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Sopa de fideo
dishes.veganApproach: Toast the fideo in oil and simmer it in a tomato broth made with vegetable stock.
dishes.technique: Thin fideo noodles are toasted golden in oil before being simmered in a blended tomato, onion and garlic broth.

sources.title: Sopa de Fideo (Mexican Noodle Soup) - Dora's Table
Sopa de Fideo - Mexican Made Meatless

dishes.name: Caldo tlalpeño
dishes.nameEn: Smoky chipotle chickpea and vegetable soup
dishes.veganApproach: Use vegetable broth and let the chickpeas and vegetables carry the smoky chipotle soup without chicken.
dishes.technique: A broth is simmered with chickpeas and vegetables, flavored with chipotle and epazote, and served with avocado and lime.

sources.title: Caldo tlalpeño estilo vegetariano con garbanzos y chipotle - Cocina Delirante

dishes.name: Sopa tarasca
dishes.veganApproach: Blend the beans with vegetable broth and finish with avocado and a dairy-free crema instead of cheese and cream.
dishes.technique: Cooked beans are puréed with roasted tomato and ancho chile into a creamy soup topped with fried tortilla strips and crisp chile.

dishes.name: Ceviche de pescado
dishes.veganApproach: Marinate chopped hearts of palm or cauliflower with the same lime, tomato, onion, cucumber and chile and serve on tostadas.
dishes.technique: Diced raw fish is cured in lime juice, then mixed with tomato, onion, chile and herbs and piled on crisp tostadas.

sources.title: Puerto Vallarta Ceviche Tostadas - Pati Jinich
Mexican Ceviche de Pescado - Maricruz Avalos
Vegan Baja Ceviche Tostadas - Dora's Table

dishes.name: Aguachile
dishes.technique: Butterflied raw shrimp are drowned in a blended lime, chile and cilantro liquid just before serving so they barely cure.

sources.title: Aguachile de camarón estilo Sinaloa - Marco Beteta

dishes.name: Cóctel de camarón
dishes.technique: Poached shrimp are served chilled in a tangy tomato, lime and ketchup broth with avocado, cucumber and onion, with saltines on the side.

sources.title: Mexican Shrimp Cocktail (Cóctel de Camarón) - America's Test Kitchen

dishes.name: Camarones a la diabla
dishes.nameEn: Deviled shrimp in fiery red chile sauce
dishes.technique: Shrimp are quickly seared and then simmered in a fiery blended sauce of dried red chiles and tomato.

sources.title: Camarones a la Diabla - Isabel Eats
Camarones a la Diabla Recipe - The Kitchn

dishes.name: Camarones al mojo de ajo
dishes.technique: Garlic is slowly cooked in oil until sweet and golden (mojo de ajo), then shrimp are flash-cooked in it and finished with lime.

sources.title: Quick-Fried Shrimp with Sweet Toasty Garlic (Camarones al Mojo de Ajo) - Rick Bayless, Food Network
Camarones al Mojo de Ajo - Isabel Eats

dishes.name: Pescado a la veracruzana
dishes.nameEn: Veracruz-style fish with olives and capers
dishes.technique: Fish is gently simmered or baked in a tomato sauce studded with olives, capers and pickled jalapeños, a Spanish-Mexican blend.

sources.title: Mahi Mahi a la Veracruzana - Rick Bayless

dishes.name: Pescado zarandeado
dishes.technique: A whole butterflied fish is brushed with a chile-citrus adobo and grilled in a hinged basket that is shaken (zarandeado) over the coals.

sources.title: Pescado Zarandeado (Grilled Fish With Chile-Citrus Sauce) - NYT Cooking
Pescado sarandeado estilo Nayarit - Marco Beteta

dishes.name: Tikin xic
dishes.nameEn: Mayan achiote fish in banana leaf
dishes.technique: Fish marinated in achiote and sour orange is wrapped in banana leaves with tomato and onion and grilled or roasted, Mayan style.

sources.title: Citrusy Black Cod Roasted in Banana Leaves (Tikin Xic) - Food & Wine

dishes.name: Arroz a la tumbada
dishes.technique: Rice is fried, then cooked loose and soupy in a tomato-seafood broth with epazote, wetter than a paella.

sources.title: Veracruz-Style Seafood and Rice (Arroz a la Tumbada) - MexConnect

dishes.name: Caldo de siete mares
dishes.technique: A chile-tomato broth built on seafood stock is loaded with several kinds of fish and shellfish, said to represent the seven seas.

sources.title: Caldo de Siete Mares (Soup of the Seven Seas) - America's Test Kitchen
Caldo de Siete Mares - Mama Maggie's Kitchen
